words.gloss: to the woman of graceful, swaying gait

literal: To the woman of swaying gait, there is there a unique beauty; when I look, she of affection gently smiles.
translation: There is a unique charm in this woman of graceful, swaying gait; when I look at her, she, filled with love, gently smiles.
modern: மெல்ல அசையும் இயல்புடைய இவளிடம் ஒரு தனி அழகு இருக்கிறது; நான் அவளைப் பார்க்கும்போது, அன்புடையவளாய் அவள் மெதுவாகப் புன்னகைக்கிறாள்.
explanation: The hero observes the subtle signs of love in the heroine's behavior. He notes that the woman of graceful, swaying gait ('அசையியல்') possesses a unique, captivating charm ('ஏஎர்') that manifests in his presence. When he looks at her, instead of turning away coldly, she responds with a soft, gentle smile ('பைய நகும்'). This gentle smile reveals her inner affection ('பசை'), confirming to him that her heart is filled with love for him.
